author: Charlene Mckenzie
content: Was a bit sceptical about booking as of previous reviews but I have got to say I am so glad i did. Alistair reassured me that previous reviews were down to technical problems with his website. So glad I booked, had an amazing time booked for my daughters first birthday. Booked the softplay, disco and bouncy castle. All the kids had a fantastic time! Alistair and crew were very professional and turned up early. Would highly recommend and would 100% use in the future.
